adoption.summary: explicit managed-copy adoption of part/sheetmetal only (millimeter units, no external dependencies, healthy features); assembly/drawing and repeat adoption of the same file are refused

direct_blend_callback.runtime_readiness: Call creo_callback_status for a live read-only probe
direct_blend_callback.instruction: One-time setup: in Creo Auxiliary Applications register registry_file (build/blend_callback_protk.dat), Start it once and review the DLL prompt yourself. For persistence across Creo restarts, merge the protkdat line from build/blend_callback.config.pro into the config.pro your Creo actually loads; the snippet is never loaded automatically. If the entry disappears after restart, fix that persistent configuration once; repeatedly selecting the dat file is temporary. An existing entry that is not running needs manual Start (delay_start true). After a payload upgrade, normally restart Creo and start the same registered application; keep its registry_file unchanged. Legacy protocol-2 registration requires one explicit migration. A changed loader/SDK generation needs a fresh Creo startup reading the same persistent registry file; a session-only registration may need selecting that file again. Query creo_callback_status before a direct Blend; only readiness=ready allows it (seed lofts via creo_new_loft_part need no callback). MCP never changes security policy.
